findings.text: Official sources confirm Green Bay beat Dallas 23-13. The Cowboys recap places Flournoy's six-yard touchdown at 52 seconds remaining, after a 13-play, 78-yard drive.
findings.confidence: HIGH for official final and drive context

findings.text: Lamb: 18 targets, nine catches, 70 yards (NBC; indexed Football Database corroboration).
findings.confidence: HIGH for attributed box results; route shares unverified

findings.text: Targets describe opportunity; realized yardage also depends on catch probability and gain distribution. A low conversion result alone cannot identify a reduced future role. Conversely, a late touchdown alone cannot establish a durable promotion.
findings.confidence: HIGH analytical distinction; future production uncertain

findings.text: Score/time context should be specified before validation. Do not discard late-drive production only after observing an inconvenient result: retain all realized scoring and evaluate predeclared script strata alongside the full-game forecast.
findings.confidence: HIGH process rationale; strata remain a proposed model choice

hypothesis.text: A partially pooled score/time opportunity model predicts subsequent targets better than extrapolating the latest full-game total without context.
hypothesis.test: Predefine deficit and time strata on training data, retain every play for realized totals, and compare against an unconditional baseline on future held-out games. Evaluate target error, predictive interval coverage and sensitivity to alternate prespecified strata; report missing play-by-play and route coverage.
hypothesis.failure_condition: Reject if improvement is unstable out of sample, arises from dropping losing predictions, or disappears after team pass volume and player participation are controlled.

prior_expectation_review: The prior public report excluded unplayed SNF. This adds its verified final and a separate opportunity-versus-conversion lesson. No preserved numerical forecast for these players is introduced or retrospectively graded.
general_hub_application: Mongo's evidence review can separate opportunity, efficiency and game script before waiver/trade/lineup synthesis. ESPN-specific availability and alternatives must be established separately before a player recommendation.
